meta.name: impeccable
meta.description: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, clarify, distill, harden, optimize, adapt, animate, colorize, extract, or otherwise improve a frontend interface. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, settings, onboarding, and empty states. Handles UX review, visual hierarchy, information architecture, cognitive load, accessibility, performance, responsive behavior, theming, anti-patterns, typography, fonts, spacing, layout, alignment, color, motion, micro-interactions, UX copy, error states, edge cases, i18n, and reusable design systems or tokens. Also use for bland designs that need to become bolder or more delightful, loud designs that should become quieter, live browser iteration on UI elements, or ambitious visual effects that should feel technically extraordinary. Not for backend-only or non-UI tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化界面设计，让网页和应用更美观、更好用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想打磨网页或应用界面的视觉与交互体验。
copy.tagline_en: Improve your website's design: layout, colors, text, and interactions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to improve the visual quality and usability of your website or app.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会把前端界面设计请求当作专业设计总监任务来办:先加载项目里的产品/设计说明，再按请求匹配到对应命令(评审、打磨、重新设计等)，最后产出有依据的界面设计、审查或修改。
howto.when: 当用户想设计、重设计或打磨任一前端界面(如网站、仪表盘)，或想让平淡的设计更大胆、让张扬的设计更安静时触发;后端或非 UI 任务不适用。

say.text: 帮我评审一下这个登录页的 UX，指出问题。
say.note: 进入 UX 评审流程，给出打分和建议。

say.text: 把这个仪表盘改成手机上好用。
say.note: 执行适配流程，调整响应式与触屏细节。

say.text: 这个主页太普通，帮我做得更大胆。
say.note: 进入 bolder 流程，放大视觉表达。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude treats frontend-interface design requests like a professional design director: it first loads the project's product/design docs, then maps the request to a command (review, polish, redesign, etc.) and delivers a grounded interface design, critique, or edit.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to design, redesign, or polish any frontend surface (website, dashboard, etc.), or make bland designs bolder or loud designs quieter. Backend or non-UI tasks are excluded.

say_en.text: Review this login page's UX and point out issues.
say_en.note: Runs the UX critique flow with findings and scores.

say_en.text: Make this dashboard work well on mobile.
say_en.note: Runs the adaptation pass for responsive and touch behavior.

say_en.text: This homepage is too plain—make it bolder.
say_en.note: Enters the bolder flow to amplify the visual statement.
